what_it_is.prose: Zen Technologies Ltd is a Hyderabad-based Indian private-sector defence technology company founded in 1993. The company designs, develops, manufactures and sells defence training simulators (live range, virtual, immersive, and constructive training solutions for weapons and allied defence equipment) and counter-drone solutions. Zen's anti-drone system works on drone detection, classification and tracking using passive surveillance and camera sensors. Recent milestones: (1) MoD awarded ₹37 crore order to Zen Technologies for an advanced Anti-Drone System; (2) Zen Technologies awarded $444,000 contract by India for anti-drone systems with hard-kill capabilities (13 October 2025, The Defense Post); (3) Zen Technologies unveiled Vyomkavach — India's first fully integrated, AI-powered anti-drone system (6 May 2026, Times of India); (4) Zen Technologies pushing for hard-kill systems against jam-resistant drones (June 2025). The company is also developing drone propulsion systems and has partnerships with HAL and other Indian defence players.
